channel.title: Copperline News
channel.description: Release write-ups and development notes for Copperline, a cycle-driven Amiga emulator written in Rust.

item.title: Copperline 1.0.0-rc.1: the first release candidate for 1.0
item.description: The first release candidate for Copperline 1.0 adds three- and four-player netplay on the desktop, debugger watches on device registers, a timed CD32 drive trace and a refreshed AROS ROM. Please test it and report anything that worked in 0.21.0 but does not now.

item.title: Copperline 0.21.0: spectators, four controllers and desktop fixes
item.description: Invite up to eight spectators to a netplay game, use four local controllers on the desktop and in RetroArch, and pick up display and file-picker fixes. Clipboard sharing and the CD32 FMV cartridge are now opt-in.

item.title: Copperline 0.20.0: Netplay, a new debugging workspace, and RetroArch
item.description: Two-player netplay, a shared debugging workspace and a RetroArch core, plus save-state thumbnails, GIF clips and Paula audio improvements.

item.title: Copperline 0.19.0: Amiga debugging from VS Code, Bartman's profiler on Copperline, and two open ROMs
item.description: Source-level debugging in VS Code, support for Bartman's visual profiler, and open-source CD32 FMV and A2091 ROMs, plus timing fixes checked against real hardware.

item.title: Copperline 0.18.0: The CD32 FMV module, calibrated drive timing, a modem on Paula, and import-uae
item.description: CD32 FMV emulation, CD drive timing measured on real hardware, and a Hayes-compatible serial modem. copperline-import-uae converts configurations from other emulators.

item.title: Copperline 0.17.0: Coppersynth, two sound boards, and CD32 discs that boot without a Kickstart
item.description: Coppersynth General MIDI, the Toccata and MHI sound boards, and CD32 discs that boot on AROS. Gamepads can now drive the whole interface.

item.title: Copperline 0.16.0: one-command WHDLoad, a game library, and a new Amiga game built on Copperline
item.description: Launch WHDLoad archives directly, browse a game library, and run freshly built Amiga programs from the command line.

item.title: Copperline 0.15.0: an MT-32, your real hard disks, and sockets with nothing to install
item.description: Roland MT-32 emulation, access to the host's physical hard disks, and guest sockets without a TCP/IP stack. Physical floppy support moves to FluxBridge.

item.title: Copperline 0.14.0: real drives, real networks, and a 1084 on your desk
item.description: Physical floppy drives, bridged Ethernet and Picasso II RTG graphics, plus CRT shaders, rewind, input remapping and an experimental JIT.

item.title: Copperline 0.13.0: RTG, Ethernet and a Linux login prompt
item.description: Z3660 RTG graphics and user-mode NAT networking, plus the MMU and display work needed to boot Linux/m68k.

item.title: Copperline moves to its own GitHub organization
item.description: The repositories move from LinuxJedi to CopperlineHQ as the project's community grows. Existing repository links keep redirecting.

item.title: Copperline 0.12.0: the browser build and the big boxes
item.description: Copperline comes to the browser. On the desktop, A3000 and A4000 profiles, writable host directories and a JSON-RPC control protocol arrive.

item.title: Copperline 0.11.0: boot from a host directory
item.description: Boot from a host directory, with blitter, CPU and sprite timing fixes and lower frame times on slower hosts.

item.title: Copperline 0.10.0: the 68060, the MMUs and a much bigger debugger
item.description: 68060 support, 68030/040 MMU and cache modelling, and new debugger inspectors, plus A4091 SCSI and MIDI and TCP serial bridges.

item.title: Copperline 0.9.0: the FPU deep-dive
item.description: An 80-bit FPU accuracy pass, explicit joystick input selection, and save states that restore without the original ROM file.

item.title: Copperline 0.8.0
item.description: The no-config machine launcher, external WASM Zorro board plugins, A2065 Ethernet with a loopback backend, and a long list of sprite, Denise and bitplane timing fixes.

item.title: Copperline 0.7.0
item.description: Expanded machine profiles, conditional and counted breakpoints, warp-speed frame skipping, and the first macOS .dmg release builds.
